readOnly: Read only: the settings managers make changes.

description.platform: The GUIDU OAuth app, used by every customer (a single Google verification), and the scopes offered to the workspaces.
description.partner: Your own OAuth app, optional, so the consent shows your brand, and the scopes your customers may use.

description.platform: Create the app in Google Cloud, register the redirect URL below and enter the Client ID and Client Secret. The secret is encrypted and never shown again.
description.partner: Without your own app, your customers connect through the GUIDU app. With it, Google's consent shows your brand; the app needs the same redirect URL and Google's verification.

app.secretHint: The secret is never shown again; to change it, type the new one.
app.verificationHint: Sheets and Calendar are sensitive scopes: without verification, only the app's test accounts can connect.
app.removeHint: Your customers go back to the GUIDU app and must connect their Google account again.

description.platform: What the workspaces may authorize. Partners may turn scopes off for their customers.
description.partner: What your customers may authorize, within what the platform offers.

drive_file.label: Google Drive
drive_file.description: Only the files the customer picks for the agent.

spreadsheets.label: Sheets
spreadsheets.description: Read and write spreadsheets, such as the contacts and leads one.

calendar_events.label: Calendar
calendar_events.description: Check and book events in the calendar.

errors.invalid: Check the Client ID and the verification status.
errors.notOffered: Scope not offered by the platform.
errors.noApp: The Google integration has not been set up yet.
errors.appChanged: The Google app changed during the connection. Try again.
errors.exchange: Google did not complete the connection. Try again.

workspace.title: Integrations
workspace.description: External accounts the workspace connects for the agents to use.

google.title: Google account
google.description: Connect the business's Google account. The agents will use Sheets, Calendar and Drive when those tools arrive.

blocked.no_app: The platform has not set up the Google integration yet.
blocked.no_scopes: No Google scope is offered to this workspace.
blocked.no_redirect: The platform's redirect address is not configured.

google.unverified: The app has no Google verification yet: Google may show a warning on the consent screen.

result.denied: The connection was canceled at Google.
result.invalid: The connection expired or was not started by you. Try again.
result.failed: The connection with Google could not be completed. Try again.
